map.Morse 跌倒风险评估量表快速计算。: Score the six Morse fall scale items including fall history, secondary diagnosis, ambulatory aid, IV therapy, gait and mental status, and read the risk level.
map.📖 查看「跌倒风险 Morse 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Morse Fall Risk User Guide"
map.Morse 量表总分 = 各条目得分之和: Morse scale total = sum of all item scores
map.≤24 低风险，25-50 中风险，>50 高风险: ≤24 low risk, 25-50 moderate risk, >50 high risk
map.住院筛查：入院/病情变化时评 Morse 跌倒风险: Inpatient screening: assess Morse fall risk on admission or when condition changes
map.护理分级：据评分定防跌干预强度: Care grading: set the intensity of fall-prevention interventions by the score
map.质量改进：统计高风险率改进流程: Quality improvement: track the high-risk rate to improve the workflow
map.算法（Morse 量表）：总分 = 近期跌倒史+继发诊断+行走辅助+静脉治疗/留: Algorithm (Morse scale): total = recent fall history + secondary diagnosis + ambulatory aid + IV therapy/heparin lock + gait + mental status, the sum of six items; grading: ≤24 low risk, 25-50 moderate risk, >50 high risk. Each item is scored per the scale (e.g. recent fall history 0/25, gait 0/10/20).
map.例1（全部高危条目默认 25+15+15+20+10+15）：总分 100 分，: Example 1 (all high-risk items at default 25+15+15+20+10+15): total 100, high risk. Example 2 (all 0): 0 points, low risk. Example 3 (10×5+0=50): 50 points, the moderate-risk boundary.
map.Morse 和 Hendrich 区别？: What is the difference between Morse and Hendrich?
map.Morse 用于成人住院跌倒筛查（6 项），Hendrich II 含意识与用药: Morse is for adult inpatient fall screening (6 items), while Hendrich II includes consciousness and medication; different departments choose different scales, and Morse is the most commonly used.
map.评完高风险管理？: How to manage once high risk is assessed?
map.加床栏、防跌标识、陪护、环境整理、评估用药（镇静/降压）、必要的约束评估；非工具: Add bed rails, fall-prevention signs, accompany the patient, tidy the environment, review medication (sedatives/antihypertensives) and assess restraints if needed; this is outside the tool's scope and must follow nursing standards.
